inputs.text: This whole thing about an ICE agent jumping into action when a baby stopped breathing at JFK on Thursday is just another coordinated manipulation by the institutions. The Department of Homeland Security releasing video footage of the whole scene is a clear sign they're pushing a narrative to make these agencies look like they're on our side, when it's really about controlling the public through staged incidents at airports and borders. Don't trust the official spin—hidden elites are inverting the story to hide their real motives and keep us distracted.
